name: The Scrap Reclamation Yard
effect: Swap any two components on any two of your ships anywhere. Your ship must be here. Illegal if either ship would exceed slot or capacity limits after the swap.

name: Black Market Trading Depot
effect: Swap up to 2 resources in this ship's cargo for any 2 resources (never VM) from the general supply. Cargo size unchanged.

name: EMP Array Substation
effect: Each other player chooses one of their own ready action tokens and exhausts it. Players with no ready tokens are unaffected.

name: Overclocking Relay
effect: Turn over one of your exhausted action tokens (general, Move, or officer) with no resource cost, once per Interact.

name: Graviton Warp Conduit
effect: Pay 1 resource from one of your ships' cargo here. One of your ships in this sector (not necessarily the Interacting ship) takes a Move without a Move token at +1 speed, may traverse half warp gates, and is not blocked by enemies for that movement. Interact is blocked if opposing ships are present.

name: Automated Nanite Station
effect: At the end of the game round, each ship in this sector repairs 1 damage cube (not components). Works while opposing ships are present.

name: Solar Flare Sanctuary
effect: Each ship that was in this sector at the start of the Action phase gets +1 to attack dice and +1 to evasion checks for the whole game round, even if it leaves.

name: Deep-Space Tactical Sensor Array
effect: Look at the top 2 enemy cards and return them to the top or bottom in any order.

name: Encrypted Archives Station
effect: Choose one of the four sector asset decks, look at its top 5 cards, and return them in any order. Only you see the cards.

name: System Defence Grid
effect: If a ship of a different owner enters this sector (including passing through), that owner must exhaust a ready Tactical token before the Move. Own ships enter freely.

name: Sensor Buoy Network
effect: While you have a ship here, every draw from your own actions is draw two, keep one (upgrade deck, enemy explore, Intelligence Bureau). The other card is discarded. Maintenance refills are unaffected.

name: Volatile Helium Nebula
effect: When a ship enters, it may gain 1 H3 into cargo (every entry). At end of the Action phase, each ship here must discard 1 cargo resource to supply or take 1 damage.

name: Dense Asteroid Field
effect: Leaving by Move costs +1 Speed. Evade and Retreat from this sector always succeed. Gravitic Anchor's 2-resource cost still applies to tactical Evade.

name: Fleet Command Substation
effect: All your other ships gain +1 to attack dice for the rest of the game round.

name: Free-Trade Logistics Hub
effect: While you have a ship here, each purchase you make (upgrades, crew, new ships) costs 1 fewer resource, minimum 0, once per purchase. Ability costs are not purchases.

name: Smuggler's Foundry
effect: This ship takes any number of damage cubes on free hull slots (cannot destroy itself), and moves 1 cargo resource to your pool for each cube.

name: Intelligence Bureau
effect: Choose one face-up mission in the shared mission market, discard it, and replace it from the mission deck. No replacement if the deck is empty.

name: Subspace Disruption Array
effect: This ship pays 1 QP from its cargo to supply. Each other player exhausts up to 2 ready Move tokens (or all they have if fewer).

name: System Regulator Node
effect: Target any planet on the board. Add or remove 1 damage cube on its supply area and/or 1 on its demand area (stacking allowed).

name: Personnel Transporter
effect: Move any number of crew between any two of your ships anywhere, subject to crew capacity (may remove crew to make room). Officer tokens keep ready/exhausted state.

name: Officer Training Command
effect: Pay 2 resources from your pool to turn over one of your exhausted action tokens, once per Interact.

name: Commerce Guild Outpost
effect: Passive: each Maintenance, the first-player adds 1 resource of their choice to this hex (at most one of each type). Interact: take 1 resource from the hex into your pool.
